requirement: Use SQLite persistence with directly written CREATE, INSERT and SELECT queries; data survives application and container replacement.
verification: Inspect SQL and reproduce restart persistence.

requirement: Submit an ERD, relational schema, data dictionary, key constraints and deletion policy.
verification: Peer maps every stored feature to a reviewed relation.

requirement: Registration requires email, username and password; normalize under P09 policy; reject duplicate normalized email and username with 409 and invalid fields with 422.
verification: Race duplicate registration: one member and one conflict.

requirement: Hash every password with the prepared versioned scrypt record or a preapproved equivalent; never store or log plaintext credentials.
verification: Inspect DB/logs and verify correct and incorrect credentials.
origin: Academy: source bonus promoted to baseline

requirement: Login verifies credentials, issues an opaque cookie session, permits only one active session per member, enforces an 8-hour server expiry and supports POST logout.
verification: Second browser login revokes first; copied expired/revoked tokens fail.

requirement: Only authenticated members may create posts and comments; guests may read public posts and comments. Author identity comes from the session.
verification: Direct guest writes fail without persisted changes.

requirement: A post has a nonblank 1–120-code-point title, 1–5000-code-point body and 1–5 distinct existing categories; comment body is 1–5000. Creation and category linkage are atomic.
verification: An invalid final category produces no partial post.
origin: Source categories plus academy field bounds

requirement: Authenticated members may like or dislike both posts and comments. One current reaction per member-target; repeat set is idempotent, opposite set switches, clear removes.
verification: All nine state transitions and both target types pass.

requirement: Every visitor sees correct like and dislike counts, including zeros. Multiple categories/comments must not multiply counts.
verification: Two-category, three-comment fixture has exact hand-calculated counts.

requirement: Filter posts by category, the logged-in member’s created posts, and the logged-in member’s currently liked posts. Combined filters use AND; private filters require login.
verification: Guest mine/liked requests fail; client-supplied member ID is ignored.

requirement: Use native HTML and server rendering without React, Angular, Vue or other frontend frameworks. Provide labelled forms, usable empty/error pages and safe escaped text.
verification: Keyboard workflow and hostile-text fixture pass.

requirement: Handle method/path/input/domain/server/storage errors with the prepared status policy; never expose SQL, stack traces, passwords or private paths.
verification: Malformed requests and injected faults leave the server usable.

requirement: Use Docker with locked dependencies, supported platform documentation, a non-root application process and persistent database directory.
verification: A teammate builds and replaces the container from the README.

requirement: Protect unsafe forms with CSRF and route authorization; private responses use an explicit cache policy. Maintain isolated unit and integration checks.
verification: Forged form, forged member ID and failed transaction cause no write.

requirement: Document modular contracts, configuration, seed data, backup/restore and each team member’s reviewed contribution.
verification: Every member can change and explain a component they did not originally author.

requirement: Support both Google and GitHub for first-time registration and returning-user login. Local credential login remains usable.
verification: Live demo with each provider plus local login.

requirement: Use authorization-code flow with browser-bound, five-minute, single-use state and S256 PKCE; exact callback URIs and provider errors are handled.
verification: Replay, cross-browser state, expired attempt and wrong verifier all fail.

requirement: Verify Google OIDC signature, issuer, audience, expiry, algorithm policy and nonce through maintained verification code and trusted discovery/JWKS.
verification: Synthetic wrong-claim tests create no account/session.

requirement: Fetch authenticated GitHub identity server-side; key it by stable provider user ID and handle private/missing verified email through explicit onboarding.
verification: Renamed login retains account; missing email does not invent identity.

requirement: Persist unique provider+subject to member mappings; repeated/concurrent login does not duplicate accounts. Matching email alone never links an existing member.
verification: Email collision cannot take over a local account.

requirement: If offering provider linking, require current account proof, recent reauthentication and a browser-bound link intent; reject a provider identity linked elsewhere.
verification: Cross-account link conflict leaves original mapping intact.

requirement: Keep secrets/tokens server-side, bound outbound calls and sanitize errors; do not use provider tokens as forum session cookies.
verification: Timeout/oversize scenarios fail safely; secret-marker scan is clean.

requirement: Issue the existing forum session after identity resolution, enforce old-session invalidation and preserve all F01 guards and tests.
verification: SSO login in browser B revokes browser A; base regression passes.

requirement: Registered users can create a post with text and one image; text-only posting still works and guests cannot upload.
verification: Member uploads and guest rejection leave correct rows/files.

requirement: Posts display their image to permitted readers, including guests when the parent post is public.
verification: Public post detail renders the verified image after restart.

requirement: Support at least JPEG, PNG and GIF, including accepted animated GIFs; decode actual content rather than trusting extension or MIME.
verification: All formats pass; renamed text and corrupt images fail.

requirement: Enforce 20,000,000 bytes per file; reject 20,000,001 with 413 and an image-too-big message. Whole request is at most 21,000,000 bytes; at most 8 fields, 1 file and 9 parts; each field at most 16 KiB. Native form repeats category up to five times.
verification: Byte-boundary and chunked-upload tests pass.
origin: Source 20 mb made precise by academy decimal-MB policy

requirement: Enforce P17 width, height, frame and total-pixel budgets with bounded decoding; oversized/corrupt content returns 422.
verification: Dimension and animation boundary tests pass.
origin: Academy interpretation of source dimension caution

requirement: Use generated private storage keys, safe verified serving headers, cleanup on every failure and reconciliation of crash leftovers; persist asset directories in Docker.
verification: Aborted upload and failed post linkage leave no public orphan.

requirement: Require session, origin and CSRF checks, preserve F01 atomic category creation, errors and tests; apply parent visibility if moderation is installed.
verification: Forged upload fails; guessed pending asset is denied in integrated mode.

requirement: Serve HTTPS with a certificate and private key; development trust is explicit and deployed trust uses a valid CA-issued hostname certificate with renewal documentation.
verification: Verified HTTPS request and wrong-hostname failure.

requirement: Document certificate authority, hostname/SAN verification, TLS protocol floor and negotiated cipher concepts; use reviewed runtime defaults and minimum TLSv1.2.
verification: Inspect certificate and protocol without globally bypassing verification.
origin: Source cipher recommendation made an academy explanation task

requirement: Enforce login identifier/IP and authenticated-write rate policies from P19; return 429 with Retry-After and bound costly concurrent work and limiter key storage.
verification: Budget, boundary, spoofed-header and work-count tests pass.

requirement: Retain measured versioned password hashing and unique salted records; passwords are hashed, not reversibly encrypted.
verification: Correct/incorrect verification and plaintext/log scans pass.

requirement: Keep session state server-side with unique random opaque cookies, digests, one active session, idle/absolute expiration, logout revocation and privilege-change rotation.
verification: Fixation, forged/revoked token and simultaneous-login tests pass.

requirement: Protect unsafe routes with session/CSRF/origin rules, escape rendered text, bind SQL values and deploy reviewed safe headers/private cache policy.
verification: Forged form and hostile-content tests produce no unauthorized mutation.

requirement: Handle security/technical failures without exposing secrets and test pressure against a disposable instance; keep keys out of source/image layers.
verification: Injected faults and log scans pass; image excludes private keys.

requirement: Retain the F01 suite and, for installed optional features, re-run their callback/upload/visibility guards under HTTPS and rate limits.
verification: Every installed workflow passes hardened-mode regression.

requirement: Implement four access types: guests read published content; users create/comment/react; moderators review/delete/report posts; admins administer roles, reports, posts/comments and categories.
verification: Complete matrix tested through direct requests.

requirement: Hold new posts pending until authorized approval; publish or reject through auditable transitions; authors see their own pending status and moderators cannot self-approve.
verification: Pending content is public only after approved transition.

requirement: Moderators can delete existing posts and report posts to administrators with a stored reason.
verification: Delete and report routes enforce moderator role.

requirement: Users can request moderator status; admin can approve/reject the request and promote or demote users to/from moderator.
verification: Role request and audited decision persist.

requirement: Admins receive reports, respond to them and resolve them; reporter can read the persisted response.
verification: Report→admin inbox→response→resolution demonstrated.

requirement: Admins can delete both posts and comments. Deleted content is excluded from public views.
verification: Direct comment deletion by admin succeeds; ordinary member denied.

requirement: Admins can create and delete categories; an attached category deletion returns 409 under the prepared retention policy.
verification: Unused category deleted; attached category remains intact.

requirement: Bootstrap admin through the operator procedure; public registration cannot assign privileged roles; protect the final admin.
verification: Role spoof and final-admin race fail safely.

requirement: Read current roles on every action, apply demotion immediately, guard all detail/feed/filter/count routes and installed image assets against pending/deleted leakage.
verification: Old demoted cookie and guessed restricted IDs fail.

requirement: Enforce expected-state/version transitions atomically with actor/reason/time audit; conflicting reviews return 409; retain F01 and installed-feature checks.
verification: Simultaneous approve/reject has one winner and one conflict.

requirement: Notify post owners when other members comment or change a post reaction to like/dislike; do not notify self-actions or unchanged repeated reactions.
verification: One correct recipient notification per meaningful change.

requirement: Persist notification intent with the domain change, deliver idempotently and authorize recipient-only reads/read-marking.
verification: Rollback creates no event; dispatcher replay creates no duplicate.

requirement: Provide durable offline notification inbox with read/unread state; normal refresh is the required transport and optional real-time delivery must have separate completed prep.
verification: Offline recipient sees committed notifications on next visit.
origin: Academy delivery contract; source does not mandate a push protocol

requirement: Activity page shows the logged-in user’s authored posts and where they currently liked/disliked posts or comments.
verification: Cleared/switched reactions move to correct current sections.

requirement: Activity page shows where and what the user commented, including comment text plus parent post context and a permitted link or neutral tombstone.
verification: Comment fixture includes both content and parent context.

requirement: Provide owner-only edit/remove sections for both posts and comments, with server ownership checks and CSRF protection.
verification: Nonowner spoof fails; owner edits/removes both content types.

requirement: Reject stale edits with 409 using expected versions; soft deletion applies the prepared child, reaction, asset and notification visibility policy.
verification: Two editors cannot silently overwrite; deleted parents do not leak.

requirement: If moderation is installed, editing published content requeues it for review and withdraws public/asset visibility until approved; privileged overrides follow its matrix.
verification: Moderated edit becomes pending; no public leak.

requirement: Use session-derived activity ownership, stable bounded pagination, correct SQL and justified indexes; retain all installed-feature tests.
verification: Actor spoof fails; exact rows unchanged by index optimization.

requirement: Optional genuine live-database encryption and key recovery; ordinary SQLite plus PRAGMA key is insufficient.
verification: Right-key/incorrect-key/ordinary-reader, export parity, rotation and encrypted restore checks.
